brand.description: Secure OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect authorization.

login.title: Sign in to your account
login.subtitle: Enter your credentials to continue.
login.invalidCredentials: The username or password is incorrect.

consent.title: Authorization consent
consent.subtitle: Choose the permissions you want to grant to this application.
consent.permissionsHelp: You can review and deselect any permission before continuing.
consent.invalidRequest: The authorization request is missing required information.
consent.scopeDefault: Allow this application to use this permission.

scopeDescriptions.openid: Confirm your identity using OpenID Connect.

invalid_request.title: Invalid request
invalid_request.description: The request is missing required information or contains an invalid parameter.

invalid_client.title: Invalid client
invalid_client.description: The client could not be authenticated or the client information is invalid.

invalid_grant.title: Invalid authorization grant
invalid_grant.description: The authorization grant is invalid, expired, revoked, or does not match the request.

invalid_redirect_uri.title: Invalid redirect URI
invalid_redirect_uri.description: One or more redirect URIs in the request are invalid.

unauthorized_client.title: Unauthorized client
unauthorized_client.description: This client is not authorized to use the requested authorization method.

unsupported_response_type.title: Unsupported response type
unsupported_response_type.description: The requested OAuth 2.0 response type is not supported.

invalid_scope.title: Invalid scope
invalid_scope.description: The requested scope is invalid, unknown, malformed, or not allowed for this client.

invalid_token.title: Invalid token
invalid_token.description: The access token is invalid, expired, or revoked.

insufficient_scope.title: Insufficient scope
insufficient_scope.description: The access token does not have sufficient permissions for this request.

unsupported_grant_type.title: Unsupported grant type
unsupported_grant_type.description: The requested OAuth 2.0 grant type is not supported.

unsupported_token_type.title: Unsupported token type
unsupported_token_type.description: The provided token type is not supported for this operation.

temporarily_unavailable.title: Service temporarily unavailable
temporarily_unavailable.description: The authorization service cannot process the request right now. Please try again later.

server_error.title: Request could not be completed
server_error.description: An unexpected error occurred while processing the request.

not_found.title: Page not found
not_found.description: The requested page could not be found.
